meta.name: service-mesh-observability
meta.description: Implement comprehensive observability for service meshes including distributed tracing, metrics, and visualization. Use when setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency issues, or implementing SLOs for service communication.

copy.tagline: 监控服务网格的分布式追踪与指标,快速定位延迟问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在运行微服务架构,想看清服务间的调用链和延迟瓶颈。
copy.tagline_en: Monitor service mesh traces and metrics to fix latency issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run microservices and need clear visibility into service-to-service latency.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按可观测性三支柱（指标、追踪、日志）和黄金信号来规划服务网格监控：帮你设计分布式追踪、设置告警阈值、生成仪表板方案，并指导调试延迟与错误问题。
howto.when: 当你设置服务网格监控、排查延迟或错误、为服务通信定义 SLO 时触发。

say.text: 帮我为 Istio 网格配置分布式追踪。
say.note: Claude 会给出追踪部署与采样建议。

say.text: 如何给服务网格设置黄金信号告警？
say.note: Claude 会说明延迟、流量、错误、饱和度的告警阈值。

say.text: 这个服务的 P99 延迟过高，帮我排查。
say.note: Claude 会结合追踪与指标定位瓶颈。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude follows the three pillars of observability (metrics, traces, logs) and golden signals to plan service mesh monitoring: it helps design distributed tracing, set alert thresholds, generate dashboard plans, and guide debugging of latency and errors.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are setting up mesh monitoring, debugging latency or errors, or defining SLOs for service communication.

say_en.text: Set up distributed tracing for my Istio mesh.
say_en.note: Claude provides tracing deployment and sampling guidance.

say_en.text: How do I set golden-signal alerts for the mesh?
say_en.note: Claude explains alert thresholds for latency, traffic, errors, saturation.

say_en.text: My service's P99 latency is too high; help me debug.
say_en.note: Claude locates bottlenecks using traces and metrics.
